items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 19 November 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the southern British Isles. Ridge of high pressure gradually building in the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, decreasing northeast 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, then becoming variable 3 or less in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight overnight, then decreasing smooth or slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers at first.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, gradually increasing east or southeast 4 or 5 Saturday morning, then 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
